reading: The sketch is a log-monitoring dashboard: a left icon sidebar, a top filter bar with service/level search syntax, a dropdown and orange Run button, a filter-pills row, a bar chart of log volume over time, a scrollable error/warn log list, and a right-hand docs-style detail panel with a JSON trace code block. All text content and exact styling come from the typed notes attached to each stroke group, which take precedence over the rough ink shapes.
